content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a question. I am converting a 4-20mA signal to 0-10V using this signal converter, [url]. Can anyone suggest how to connect it to the AI8 input of the [product_name]? Thanks in advance. [user_name]

Hi, the I8 terminal on a [product_name] basis module functions as an analog input (0-10V). In the program, it shows up as AI2. Your chosen analog converter with galvanic isolation can be connected since its output is 0-10V.

Thanks for the reply. The signal part is clear. My next question is: does anyone have a wiring diagram or schematic for connecting this converter to the [product_name]? Appreciate any help. [user_name]
According to the product datasheet, for voltage output, terminals 6-1 should be connected to the [product_name]. Regards

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for guidance on hardware connections to interface a third-party 4-20mA to 0-10V signal converter with the analog input on a [product_name] module. While compatibility is confirmed and datasheet references are given, users remain uncertain about the exact wiring procedure, showing a need for more detailed and specific physical connection instructions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks straightforward and detailed instructions or a wiring diagram to properly connect the signal converter's voltage output to the analog input of the [product_name].
